articles.title: Connect to MCP servers - Claude
articles.comment:
Add an MCP server to Claude Code, verify the connection, and find the configuration on disk.

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets Claude Code use tools beyond its built-in set, such as searching an issue tracker, querying a database, or controlling a web browser.
